Markets.title: US stocks:  US market posts weekly gains with earnings, inflation data on tap
Markets.summary: US stocks posted weekly gains as Wall Street finished strong on Friday, driven by optimism ahead of third-quarter earnings from major banks like Wells Fargo and Goldman Sachs. Meanwhile, oil prices initially dipped from conflicting US-Iran news before recovering, even as concerns about consumer sentiment persisted.

Markets.title: Gold, silver boom puts US bank trading revenues on track for record $5 billion
Markets.summary: Driven by high demand, major banks generated significant earnings from trading gold and silver in the first half of 2026. Analysts predict these precious metals desks are on track to reach a record $5 billion in trading revenues for the year.

Markets.title: US bull market nears fourth anniversary, but narrow rally raises risks
Markets.summary: The US stock bull market is approaching its fourth anniversary, supported by strong corporate earnings and low volatility. However, risks are rising due to a narrow rally heavily reliant on artificial intelligence and a disparity in individual stock performances.

Markets.title: Anthem Biosciences block deal: Portsmouth Technologies sells 30 lakh shares worth Rs 250 crore
Markets.summary: Portsmouth Technologies sold 30 lakh shares of Anthem Biosciences in a block deal on October 9 for Rs 249.90 crore. The transaction significantly decreases Portsmouth's stake in the company, which recently reported a decline in first-quarter income and profit for FY27.

Markets.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 profit surges fivefold as income rises
Markets.summary: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a more than fivefold increase in net profit for the second quarter, driven by higher net interest and fee income. The growth was further supported by strong disbursements in new loan products and improvements in asset quality.

Markets.title: Rupee recovers to 96.73 vs US dollar after RBI intervention, but dollar demand persists
Markets.summary: The rupee recovered slightly to 96.73 per US dollar following heavy intervention by the Reserve Bank of India. However, overall sentiment remained pressured by ongoing corporate dollar demand, a 7% year-to-date decline, and falling foreign exchange reserves.

Geo-Political.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced a new trade deal permitting Russia to sell diesel fuel internationally. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized the agreement, calling it a "gift to Putin" that will prolong the war.

Geo-Political.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
Geo-Political.summary: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court, prompting the tribunal to condemn the action as an assault on the rule of law. Several member states, including the United Kingdom, stated they strongly disagree with the US sanctions.

Geo-Political.title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
Geo-Political.summary: Nidal Hasan's planned execution by firing squad would mark the first military execution in over 60 years. JD Vance has expressed doubt regarding this execution method and stated that he will not watch it.

Geo-Political.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
Geo-Political.summary: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, causing damage to local buildings. Following the disaster, authorities issued tsunami warnings for neighboring countries.

Geo-Political.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
Geo-Political.summary: Russian search engine and tech firm Yandex warned customers of potential digital service disruptions. The warning follows Ukrainian military strikes on the company's data centres.

Geo-Political.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
Geo-Political.summary: A left-wing candidate named Hitler Mussolini won a narrow mayoral victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes. Exit polls confirmed the election results in the region.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates a shift in digital marketing from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to help digital creators stay ahead in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing content creation and streamlining the production process for creators.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: CEA bats for a review of loan overdue rules for MSMEs
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has urged policymakers to adjust loan overdue regulations to match the actual cash-flow cycles of MSMEs. He argued that authorities should replace rigid global standards with flexible rules tailored specifically to small businesses.

Data & Insights.title: EU-China trade breakthrough: Beijing agrees to moderate hybrid car exports by more than half | Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: The European Union and China reached an agreement to significantly reduce hybrid car exports to the bloc. This deal is intended to ease mounting trade tensions between the two regions.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council Meeting Oct 2026: List of decisions taken - arrest, prosecution, general penalty and more
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council removed arrest powers for officers and raised the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore during its October 2026 meeting. The meeting also resulted in reduced general penalties, faster refunds, and simplified registration processes.

Data & Insights.title: Homecooked food gets expensive, vegetarians to pay more than non-vegetarians amid onion, rice, LPG price hike: Crisil
Data & Insights.summary: In September 2026, the cost of a home-cooked vegetarian thali rose to ₹30.8 from ₹28.1 the previous year. Concurrently, a non-vegetarian thali increased from ₹56 to ₹59.5 due to rising prices for onions, rice, and LPG.

Data & Insights.title: India signs pact to address global excess capacity: What is it? Who are the 15 signatories? Check joint statement
Data & Insights.summary: India and 14 other economies signed a pact to address and take action against policies that cause global excess manufacturing capacity and distort markets. The signatories will share information and develop coordinated responses to these economic issues.

India.title: Man Arrested With Marijuana Worth Rs 4.5 Crore At Delhi Airport
India.summary: An Indian passenger arriving from Bangkok was arrested at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport. Customs officials seized 12.85 kg of suspected marijuana valued at approximately Rs 4.5 crore from the traveler.

India.title: At CJP Hearing, Centre Brings Up Sexual Harassment Of Policewoman
India.summary: During a Chief Justice of India hearing, the Centre mentioned the alleged sexual harassment of a policewoman. This development followed recent accusations by three women journalists regarding sexual harassment by police personnel.

India.title: Ambani Heir Faces Tough Questions In Meetings For Record Jio IPO
India.summary: Akash Ambani participated in global investor meetings across major international financial centers over the past four weeks. These meetings are part of preparations for a record initial public offering for Reliance Jio.

India.title: Ahead Of CJP Protest, Internet Cut For 24 Hours Around Jantar Mantar
India.summary: Delhi Police has ordered a 24-hour internet shutdown around Jantar Mantar. The restriction is implemented ahead of an upcoming protest regarding the Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA).

India.title: Delhi Protests Highlights: Number Of Delhi Metro Stations Shut Cut From 57 To 45, Hours After Supreme Court Order
India.summary: The Delhi Metro reduced the number of closed stations from 57 to 45 following a Supreme Court order. The closures were implemented ahead of a protest organized by the Cockroach Janata Party against the election commission chief.

India.title: Metro, Rail Curbs, 20,000 Personnel: Delhi Gears Up For CJP's Jantar Mantar 2.0
India.summary: Delhi is deploying over 20,000 security personnel and implementing metro and rail restrictions for CJP's Jantar Mantar 2.0 protest. Additionally, authorities have installed more than 300 CCTV cameras with audio recording capabilities at sensitive locations across the city.

General.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'
General.summary: Donald Trump announced a deal allowing Russia to sell diesel fuel to the United States and other markets. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized the agreement as a gift to Vladimir Putin that will prolong the war.

General.title: NI secretary to ban the Drumcree parade
General.summary: The Northern Ireland secretary plans to ban the Drumcree parade in Portadown. This decision follows a nearly two-week stand-off between Orangemen and nationalist residents on Garvaghy Road.

General.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
General.summary: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court, prompting the tribunal to condemn the move as an assault on the rule of law. Several member states, including the UK, have stated that they strongly disagree with these sanctions.

General.title: Polanski vows to stay on as Green leader as he faces criticism after by-election defeat
General.summary: Green leader Polanski has vowed to remain in his position despite calls for his resignation from the Jewish Greens' leader. The demand follows a recent by-election defeat and a controversy surrounding Zionism.

General.title: King pays Andrew's £1.5m repair bill on Royal Lodge
General.summary: King Charles paid the £1.5m repair and restoration bill for the Royal Lodge after Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor surrendered the lease on the 30-room mansion. Andrew was originally charged these costs following the surrender of the property.

General.title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
General.summary: JD Vance expressed doubt regarding the planned firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan and stated he will not watch it. This event would mark the first military execution in the United States in over 60 years.
